h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jhansi

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Jhansi

items.pText: Jhansi, in the Bundelkhand region on the border of Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh, is known to schoolchildren across India for Rani Lakshmibai and her fort. Schools here often want a playground that carries something of Indian culture. FunPlay Systems designs and makes playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 890 km away, and sends it to Jhansi by road.

Our Funplay Originals are play structures designed by our own team, and several draw on games Indian children have played for generations. The Timeless Play series includes Chausar, based on the board game, Fugadi, a revolving pole named after the folk dance, and Patang, a swing set built around kite shapes. For a school, these become a starting point for stories and lessons as well as play. Bundelkhand's summers are very hot, so we plan shade into every layout.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Bringing Indian games into the school playground

c: Chausar is a large structure with a central tower, slides and climbers set out in the cross shape of the board, so it suits a school with a good-sized ground. Patang fits a smaller space, with kite-shaped panels, swings and hanging rings. Teachers can link both to lessons on traditional games and festivals. Place swings in open ground and taller towers where afternoon shade falls. Our Khel Khud series also takes ideas from Indian play.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 890 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: Do you make playground equipment inspired by Indian games?
items.a: Yes. Our Funplay Originals include the Timeless Play series, with structures such as Chausar, Fugadi and Patang, and the Khel Khud series, both drawing on Indian games.

items.q: How much space does Chausar need?
items.a: It is one of our larger structures and needs a good-sized ground with clear space all round. The product page lists its safe play area, and we check the fit on your layout drawing.

Yes. We send equipment from Vasai to Jhansi and the rest of Bundelkhand by road, and install it with our own team or a dealer in North India. The heat of a Bundelkhand summer is something we plan for with shade on every layout.
